collection.description: Two young Heathens discover that if they swap masks, almost nobody at camp can tell them apart.

description_variants.description: Two young Isolans discover that if they swap masks, almost nobody at camp can tell them apart.

setup.name: The scene
setup.text: (subject) and (friend) aren't twins, or even related, but they are the same height, and they have discovered that if they swap masks almost nobody at camp can tell them apart. They manage it for two whole days before (subject)'s grandmother notices that "(subject)" has suddenly forgotten how to whistle. They are given a long talking-to and a lot of extra washing up, and they both agree it was worth it.
